local json = require('json')
local log = require('log')
-- =====================================================================
-- JumpCloud Directory Insights -- SELF-AUTH collector (does its own OAuth).
--
-- HOST IT IN A SELF-SIGNING SOURCE (rule 9). DEFAULT: the TENABLE source
-- (X-ApiKeys) -- its Access/Secret Key are only stored, never read by this
-- script and not live-validated on save, so it needs NO real config values.
-- Darktrace (DTAPI-*) also works but may validate its host/token fields on save.
-- Those sources build their auth INSIDE the script, which proves the platform
-- does NOT manage/overwrite Authorization there -- so our self-built
-- Authorization headers reach JumpCloud intact. OAuth hosts (Wiz, Graph) and
-- static-inject hosts (Okta, Snyk) rewrite/strip Authorization and will NOT
-- work, because JumpCloud requires client_secret_basic which those panels
-- cannot emit.
--
-- Flow (all in this Lua):
--   1. token: POST Authorization: Basic base64(id:secret)  (client_secret_basic)
--             body "scope=api&grant_type=client_credentials"
--   2. events: POST /insights/directory/v1/events
--             Authorization: Bearer <access_token> + x-org-id
--
-- JumpCloud specifics baked in below:
--   * response is a TOP-LEVEL JSON array (ipairs(data) directly)
--   * events carry server_timestamp (NOT timestamp) -- checkpoint on that
--   * X-Search_after response header is the cursor, replayed as search_after
--   * ~90-day retention: start_time is format-checked AND age-clamped, so a
--     stale host-seeded checkpoint cannot push the request out of retention
--
-- CHKPT_SINCE must be a key the HOST source registers, or reads throw
-- NotFoundChkptId. The X-Search_after cursor is carried within a run via
-- context (not persisted); next run resumes from the timestamp checkpoint.
--
-- Deploy note: the host source may require its own auth fields (Tenable
-- Access/Secret Key, Darktrace Public/Private Token) to be non-empty to save.
-- Put any placeholder there; this script ignores config entirely.
-- =====================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIGURATION
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local JC_CLIENT_ID     = "sa_test"   -- API Service Account (sa_ prefix)
local JC_CLIENT_SECRET = "s3cret"
local JC_TOKEN_URL     = "https://admin-oauth.id.jumpcloud.com/oauth2/token"  -- US region
local JC_ORG_ID        = "sample-org-id"                          -- sent as x-org-id
local JC_API_BASE      = "https://api.jumpcloud.com"             -- EU/IN: api.eu / api.in .jumpcloud.com
local JC_SERVICES      = { "all" }
local JC_SORT          = "ASC"
local JC_LIMIT         = 1000
local JC_INITIAL_LOOKBACK_HOURS = 24
local JC_MAX_PAGE_CALLS = 10
-- Reuse a checkpoint key the HOST source registers (self-signing host, rule 9).
-- Tenable source registers SINCE_DATE_TIME; Darktrace registers
-- LAST_END_TIME_MODELBREACHES. Using an unregistered key throws NotFoundChkptId.
local CHKPT_SINCE = "SINCE_DATE_TIME"
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function trim(s)
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return s end
    return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function base64(data)
    local out = {}
    local bytes = { data:byte(1, #data) }
    local i = 1
    while i <= #bytes do
        local b1 = bytes[i]
        local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
        local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
        local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
        local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64
        local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096) % 64
        local c3 = math.floor(n / 64) % 64
        local c4 = n % 64
        out[#out + 1] = B64:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1)
        out[#out + 1] = B64:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)
        out[#out + 1] = b2 and B64:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1) or "="
        out[#out + 1] = b3 and B64:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1) or "="
        i = i + 3
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function safe_get_chkpt(key)
    local ok, val = pcall(get_chkpt, key)
    if ok then return val end
    return nil
end

local function services_copy()
    local out = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(JC_SERVICES) do out[#out + 1] = s end
    if #out == 0 then out = { "all" } end
    return out
end

local function default_start_time()
    local t = os.time() - (JC_INITIAL_LOOKBACK_HOURS * 3600)
    return os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", t)
end

function start(config)
    fetch_token()
end

-- Step 1: token via client_secret_basic (Authorization: Basic).
function fetch_token()
    local basic = base64(trim(JC_CLIENT_ID) .. ":" .. trim(JC_CLIENT_SECRET))
    fetch {
        params = {
            url     = JC_TOKEN_URL,
            method  = "POST",
            headers = {
                ["Accept"]        = "application/json",
                ["Content-Type"]  = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
                ["Authorization"] = "Basic " .. basic
            },
            body = "scope=api&grant_type=client_credentials"
        },
        fn = "process_token",
        retry = true,
        context = {}
    }
end

function process_token(config, response, context)
    if response.status == 200 then
        local data = json.decode(response.body)
        local token = data and data.access_token
        if token and token ~= "" then
            local since = safe_get_chkpt(CHKPT_SINCE)
            fetch_events(token, since, nil, JC_MAX_PAGE_CALLS)
        else
            log.error("Token response had no access_token")
        end
    else
        local detail = tostring(response.body)
        if #detail > 400 then detail = detail:sub(1, 400) end
        log.error("Token request failed (status=" .. response.status .. "). Response: " .. detail)
    end
end

local function is_rfc3339(s)
    return type(s) == "string" and s:match("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%dT%d%d:%d%d:%d%d") ~= nil
end

function fetch_events(token, since_time, search_after, page_calls_left)
    local sort = JC_SORT
    if sort ~= "DESC" then sort = "ASC" end
    -- Guard: the host source may seed the checkpoint key in a non-RFC3339
    -- format. JumpCloud requires RFC3339 start_time or it returns 400.
    if not is_rfc3339(since_time) then
        log.debug("start_time not RFC3339 (was: " .. tostring(since_time) .. "), using default lookback")
        since_time = default_start_time()
    end
    -- Clamp: JumpCloud DI keeps only ~90 days. A host-seeded checkpoint can be
    -- older than that; sending it returns 400. Floor the start_time at 89 days
    -- ago (RFC3339 Z strings are lexicographically comparable).
    local retention_floor = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", os.time() - (89 * 24 * 3600))
    if since_time < retention_floor then
        log.debug("start_time " .. since_time .. " is past 90d retention; clamping to " .. retention_floor)
        since_time = retention_floor
    end
    local body = {
        service    = services_copy(),
        start_time = since_time,
        sort       = sort,
        limit      = JC_LIMIT
    }
    if type(search_after) == "table" then
        body.search_after = search_after
    end
    local headers = {
        ["Accept"]        = "application/json",
        ["Content-Type"]  = "application/json",
        ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. tostring(token)
    }
    if JC_ORG_ID and JC_ORG_ID ~= "" then
        headers["x-org-id"] = JC_ORG_ID
    end
    fetch {
        params = {
            url     = JC_API_BASE:gsub("/+$", "") .. "/insights/directory/v1/events",
            method  = "POST",
            headers = headers,
            body    = json.encode(body)
        },
        fn = "process_events",
        retry = true,
        context = {
            token           = token,
            since_time_used = since_time,
            page_calls_left = page_calls_left
        }
    }
end

function no_nulls(d, rn)
    if type(d) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(d) do
            if type(v) == "userdata" then
                d[k] = rn
            elseif type(v) == "table" then
                no_nulls(v, rn)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function get_header(headers, name)
    if not headers then return nil end
    local lname = name:lower()
    for k, v in pairs(headers) do
        if tostring(k):lower() == lname then return v end
    end
    return nil
end

function process_events(config, response, context)
    local page_calls_left = context.page_calls_left - 1
    if response.status == 200 then
        local data = json.decode(response.body)
        no_nulls(data, nil)
        if data and type(data) == "table" then
            for _, entry in ipairs(data) do
                entry._jc_event_type = "directoryInsights"
                emit { log = entry }
            end
            if #data > 0 then
                local last_event = data[#data]
                local ts = last_event.server_timestamp or last_event.timestamp
                if ts then
                    set_chkpt(CHKPT_SINCE, ts)
                end
            end
            local search_after = get_header(response.headers, "x-search_after")
            local result_count = tonumber(get_header(response.headers, "x-result-count")) or #data
            if search_after and search_after ~= "" and result_count > 0 and page_calls_left > 0 then
                local cursor = search_after
                if type(cursor) == "string" then
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, cursor)
                    if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then cursor = decoded end
                end
                log.debug("Paging with search_after, pages left: " .. page_calls_left)
                fetch_events(context.token, context.since_time_used, cursor, page_calls_left)
            else
                log.debug("Stopping pagination (result_count=" .. tostring(result_count) .. ", pages_left=" .. page_calls_left .. ")")
            end
        else
            log.warn("No event data found in response")
        end
    elseif response.status == 401 then
        log.error("Directory Insights auth failed (401) - Bearer token rejected or Authorization stripped by the host. If stripped, this source is NOT self-auth; check the service account role, x-org-id, and region.")
    elseif response.status == 403 then
        log.error("Forbidden - service account role lacks Directory Insights, or Events Integration not enabled")
    elseif response.status == 429 then
        log.warn("Rate limit exceeded - will retry")
    elseif response.status == 400 then
        local detail = tostring(response.body)
        if #detail > 500 then detail = detail:sub(1, 500) end
        log.error("Bad request (400) from JumpCloud. Response: " .. detail)
    else
        local detail = tostring(response.body)
        if #detail > 500 then detail = detail:sub(1, 500) end
        log.error("Failed to fetch JumpCloud Directory Insights events. Status=" .. response.status .. ". Response: " .. detail)
    end
end

-- JumpCloud Directory Insights -> OCSF 1.5.0 serializer.
--
-- STANDALONE pipeline processor stage, separate from the collector
-- (jumpcloud_directory_insights_selfauth.lua). The collector emits raw
-- JumpCloud DI records; this stage receives each event and returns an OCSF
-- object. Same idiom as the Cato/Palo serializers: declarative FIELD_MAPPINGS +
-- setNestedField, getConstantFields() for class/category/uid/metadata,
-- RFC3339 time parsing, observables, lossless unmapped passthrough.
--
-- JumpCloud DI is entirely IAM activity, so every class is category 3 (IAM):
--   *_login_attempt / *_auth / radius / ldap bind / sso / mfa  -> Authentication   (3002)
--   user/admin create|update|delete|password|suspend|activate   -> Account Change   (3001)
--   *group* add|remove|associate|create|delete                  -> Group Management  (3006)
--   system/policy/command/app/org/integration/sso-connector CRUD -> Entity Management (3004)
--   anything unclassifiable                                     -> Base Event        (0)
--
-- DI records nest a lot (initiated_by.*, geoip.*, resource.*, system.*), so the
-- mapping loop reads DOTTED source paths via getNestedValue. Unmapped top-level
-- objects are still swept into `unmapped` in full, so nothing is lost.

local OCSF_VERSION = "1.5.0"
local VENDOR_NAME  = "JumpCloud"
local PRODUCT_NAME = "JumpCloud Directory Insights"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Declarative field maps: JumpCloud (dotted) field -> OCSF dotted path.
-- COMMON is applied to every event; the per-type map is applied on top.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local COMMON = {
    { source = "client_ip",             target = "src_endpoint.ip" },
    { source = "initiated_by.username", target = "actor.user.name" },
    { source = "initiated_by.email",    target = "actor.user.email_addr" },
    { source = "initiated_by.id",       target = "actor.user.uid" },
    { source = "geoip.country_code",    target = "src_endpoint.location.country" },
    { source = "geoip.region_name",     target = "src_endpoint.location.region" },
    { source = "geoip.timezone",        target = "src_endpoint.location.desc" },
    { source = "message",               target = "message" },
    { source = "error_message",         target = "status_detail" },
}

local FIELD_MAPPINGS = {
    AUTH = {
        { source = "username",         target = "user.name" },
        { source = "email",            target = "user.email_addr" },
        { source = "service",          target = "auth_protocol" },
        { source = "application.name", target = "service.name" },
        { source = "sp_name",          target = "service.name" },
        { source = "system.hostname",  target = "device.hostname" },
        { source = "system.id",        target = "device.uid" },
        { source = "system.os",        target = "device.os.name" },
    },
    ACCOUNT = {
        { source = "resource.id",    target = "user.uid" },
        { source = "resource.name",  target = "user.name" },
        { source = "resource.email", target = "user.email_addr" },
    },
    GROUP = {
        { source = "resource.id",   target = "group.uid" },
        { source = "resource.name", target = "group.name" },
        { source = "resource.type", target = "group.type" },
    },
    ENTITY = {
        { source = "resource.id",   target = "entity.uid" },
        { source = "resource.name", target = "entity.name" },
        { source = "resource.type", target = "entity.type" },
    },
    GENERIC = {},
}

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Generic helpers (nested get/set, unmapped passthrough) -- reusable.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getValue(tbl, key, default)
    local v = tbl[key]
    if v == nil then return default else return v end
end

-- Read a dotted path out of a (possibly nested) source record.
local function getNestedValue(tbl, path)
    if type(tbl) ~= "table" or path == nil then return nil end
    local current = tbl
    for key in string.gmatch(path, "[^.]+") do
        if type(current) ~= "table" then return nil end
        current = current[key]
        if current == nil then return nil end
    end
    return current
end

local function setNestedField(obj, path, value)
    if value == nil or path == nil or path == "" then return end
    local keys = {}
    for key in string.gmatch(path, "[^.]+") do
        if key and key ~= "" then table.insert(keys, key) end
    end
    if #keys == 0 then return end
    local current = obj
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local key = keys[i]
        local base = string.match(key, "(.-)%[(%d+)%]")
        if base then
            local index = tonumber(string.match(key, "%[(%d+)%]")) + 1
            if current[base] == nil then current[base] = {} end
            if current[base][index] == nil then current[base][index] = {} end
            current = current[base][index]
        else
            if current[key] == nil then current[key] = {} end
            current = current[key]
        end
    end
    local finalKey = keys[#keys]
    local base = string.match(finalKey, "(.-)%[(%d+)%]")
    if base then
        local index = tonumber(string.match(finalKey, "%[(%d+)%]")) + 1
        if current[base] == nil then current[base] = {} end
        current[base][index] = value
    else
        current[finalKey] = value
    end
end

-- A source key is "mapped" (skip in unmapped sweep) only when it is a flat
-- single-segment key we consumed. Dotted sources leave their parent object to
-- be swept into unmapped in full, so no data is lost.
local function mappedFlatKeys(fieldMappings)
    local mapped = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(fieldMappings) do
        if not string.find(v.source, ".", 1, true) then mapped[v.source] = true end
    end
    return mapped
end

local function copyUnmappedFields(event_log, fieldMappings, result)
    local mapped = mappedFlatKeys(fieldMappings)
    for k, v in pairs(event_log) do
        if not mapped[k] and v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
            setNestedField(result, "unmapped." .. k, v)
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function concatMaps(a, b)
    local out = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(a) do out[#out + 1] = v end
    for _, v in ipairs(b) do out[#out + 1] = v end
    return out
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- JumpCloud-specific classification and enums.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local CLASS      = { AUTH = 3002, ACCOUNT = 3001, GROUP = 3006, ENTITY = 3004, GENERIC = 0 }
local CLASS_NAME = { AUTH = "Authentication", ACCOUNT = "Account Change", GROUP = "Group Management", ENTITY = "Entity Management", GENERIC = "Base Event" }
local CAT        = { AUTH = 3, ACCOUNT = 3, GROUP = 3, ENTITY = 3, GENERIC = 0 }
local CAT_NAME   = { [3] = "Identity & Access Management", [0] = "Uncategorized" }

local function resolveType(e)
    local et  = string.lower(tostring(e.event_type or ""))
    local svc = string.lower(tostring(e.service or ""))
    -- Authentication first: catches admin_login_attempt, user_login_attempt,
    -- sso_auth, radius auth, ldap bind, webauthn, mfa, logout.
    if et:find("login") or et:find("logout") or et:find("logoff")
        or et:find("auth") or et:find("bind") or et:find("radius")
        or et:find("webauthn") or et:find("mfa")
        or svc == "radius" or svc == "ldap" then
        return "AUTH"
    end
    if et:find("group") then return "GROUP" end
    if et:find("user_") or et:find("admin_") or et:find("password") then return "ACCOUNT" end
    if et ~= "" then return "ENTITY" end
    return "GENERIC"
end

local function getActivityId(t, e)
    local et = string.lower(tostring(e.event_type or ""))
    if t == "AUTH" then
        if et:find("logout") or et:find("logoff") then return 2 end   -- Logoff
        return 1                                                       -- Logon
    elseif t == "ACCOUNT" then
        if et:find("create") then return 1                            -- Create
        elseif et:find("delete") then return 6                        -- Delete
        elseif et:find("password_reset") then return 4                -- Password Reset
        elseif et:find("password") then return 3                      -- Password Change
        elseif et:find("unlock") then return 12                       -- Unlock
        elseif et:find("unsuspend") or et:find("activate") or et:find("enable") then return 2  -- Enable
        elseif et:find("suspend") or et:find("disable") or et:find("lock") then return 5       -- Disable
        else return 99 end
    elseif t == "GROUP" then
        if et:find("add") or et:find("associate") or et:find("join") then return 3    -- Add User
        elseif et:find("remove") or et:find("dissociate") or et:find("leave") then return 4  -- Remove User
        else return 99 end
    elseif t == "ENTITY" then
        if et:find("create") then return 1                            -- Create
        elseif et:find("delete") then return 4                        -- Delete
        elseif et:find("update") or et:find("change") or et:find("modif") then return 3  -- Update
        elseif et:find("read") or et:find("view") or et:find("list") then return 2       -- Read
        else return 99 end
    end
    return 0
end

local function getObservables(e)
    local obs = {}
    local function add(name, type_id, value)
        if value ~= nil and value ~= "" then
            table.insert(obs, { name = name, type_id = type_id, value = tostring(value) })
        end
    end
    add("src_endpoint.ip", 2, e.client_ip)
    add("actor.user.name", 4, getNestedValue(e, "initiated_by.username"))
    add("actor.user.email_addr", 5, getNestedValue(e, "initiated_by.email"))
    add("user.name", 4, e.username)
    add("user.email_addr", 5, e.email)
    add("device.hostname", 1, getNestedValue(e, "system.hostname"))
    return obs
end

local function getConstantFields(t, event)
    local class_uid   = CLASS[t]
    local cat_uid     = CAT[t]
    local activity_id = getActivityId(t, event)
    local success     = event.success
    local fields = {
        ["activity_id"]                   = activity_id,
        ["category_uid"]                  = cat_uid,
        ["category_name"]                 = CAT_NAME[cat_uid] or "Uncategorized",
        ["class_uid"]                     = class_uid,
        ["class_name"]                    = CLASS_NAME[t] or "Base Event",
        ["type_uid"]                      = class_uid * 100 + activity_id,
        ["metadata.version"]              = OCSF_VERSION,
        ["metadata.product.vendor_name"]  = VENDOR_NAME,
        ["metadata.product.name"]         = PRODUCT_NAME,
        ["metadata.product.feature.name"] = tostring(event.service or ""),
        ["observables"]                   = getObservables(event),
        ["severity_id"]                   = 1,   -- Informational default
    }
    if event.id ~= nil and event.id ~= "" then fields["metadata.uid"] = event.id end

    -- success (boolean) -> status. Failed authentication is elevated to Medium.
    if success == true then
        fields["status_id"] = 1; fields["status"] = "Success"
    elseif success == false then
        fields["status_id"] = 2; fields["status"] = "Failure"
        if t == "AUTH" then fields["severity_id"] = 3 end
    end

    if t == "AUTH" and event.mfa == true then fields["is_mfa"] = true end
    return fields
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RFC3339 -> epoch milliseconds (timezone aware, incl. trailing Z + fraction).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function localUtcOffset()
    local now = os.time()
    local local_t = os.date("*t", now)
    local utc_t   = os.date("!*t", now)
    local_t.isdst = false
    return os.time(local_t) - os.time(utc_t)
end

local function parseTimestamp(ts)
    if type(ts) ~= "string" or ts == "" then return nil end
    local y, mo, d, h, mi, s, sign, tz_h, tz_m = ts:match(
        "^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)T(%d%d):(%d%d):(%d%d)%.?%d*([%+%-])(%d%d):(%d%d)")
    if not y then
        y, mo, d, h, mi, s = ts:match("^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d)-(%d%d)T(%d%d):(%d%d):(%d%d)%.?%d*Z?$")
        if y then sign, tz_h, tz_m = "+", "00", "00" end
    end
    if not y then return nil end
    local epoch = os.time({
        year = tonumber(y), month = tonumber(mo), day = tonumber(d),
        hour = tonumber(h), min = tonumber(mi), sec = tonumber(s), isdst = false
    })
    if not epoch then return nil end
    local tz_offset = tonumber(tz_h) * 3600 + tonumber(tz_m) * 60
    if sign == "-" then tz_offset = -tz_offset end
    return (epoch + localUtcOffset() - tz_offset) * 1000
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Entry point: one JumpCloud DI record in, one OCSF object out.
-- The collector emits records via emit{log=record}; this stage receives that
-- record directly, or under event.message if the pipeline wraps it.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function processEvent(event)
    if event == nil then return {} end
    local source = event
    if type(event.message) == "table" then source = event.message end

    local t = resolveType(source)
    local result = {}

    for key, value in pairs(getConstantFields(t, source)) do
        setNestedField(result, key, value)
    end

    -- JumpCloud event time is `timestamp`; fall back to `server_timestamp`.
    result.time = parseTimestamp(getValue(source, "timestamp", ""))
        or parseTimestamp(getValue(source, "server_timestamp", ""))

    local fieldMappings = concatMaps(COMMON, FIELD_MAPPINGS[t] or FIELD_MAPPINGS["GENERIC"])
    for _, mapping in ipairs(fieldMappings) do
        local v = getNestedValue(source, mapping.source)
        if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then setNestedField(result, mapping.target, v) end
    end
    copyUnmappedFields(source, fieldMappings, result)

    return result
end
